description: A specialized LoRA for Krea 2 Turbo , designed to generate structured subject reference sheets . This LoRA focuses on the layout, pose, and reference-sheet structure rather than one specific person or character. It is made to help create sheets with full-body turnaround views and portrait/head-angle studies in a clean, organized format. It can be used for realistic people, anime characters, fashion concepts, cosplay concepts, fantasy characters, male subjects, female subjects, stylized designs, and more.
